q.en: Who invented basketball, and in what year?
q.zh: 谁发明了篮球？在哪一年？

options.en: A coach in France, in 1900, who wanted a game to keep his students fit indoors
options.zh: 一位法国教练，1900年，想用一项运动让学生在室内保持健壮
詹姆斯·奈史密斯博士，1891年

explain.en: "Although basketball is now a global sport, it started small in 1891. Dr. James Naismith… hit gold by nailing a peach basket up on the wall."
explain.zh: “虽然篮球如今是一项全球性运动，它于1891年从小处起步。詹姆斯·奈史密斯博士……把一只桃篮钉在墙上，从而大获成功。”

q.en: How many players are on each team during a basketball game?
q.zh: 一场篮球比赛每队有多少名球员？

explain.en: "Two teams of five players play a game of basketball."
explain.zh: “篮球比赛由两支各五人的队伍进行。”

q.en: In the book, what is a "foul shot"?
q.zh: 在书中，“foul shot”（罚球）是什么？

options.en: A free throw from the foul line given after a rule is broken
options.zh: 犯规后从罚球线进行的自由投篮

options.en: A shot worth three points, taken from anywhere on the court past the free-throw line
options.zh: 值三分的投篮，在场上任何越过罚球线的地方投出

explain.en: The glossary says a foul shot is "a free throw from the foul line… given to a player after another player has broken a rule."
explain.zh: 词汇表说明 foul shot 是“在对方犯规后，从罚球线进行的自由投篮”。

q.en: In what year did the National Basketball Association (NBA) begin?
q.zh: 美国职业篮球联赛（NBA）始于哪一年？

options.en: 1992. "The tallest players ever in the NBA were Manute Bol and Gheorghe Muresan, who were both 7 feet 7 inches… Muggsy Bogues was the shortest NBA player in history, at 5 feet 3 inches."
options.zh: 1992年。“NBA史上最高的球员是马努特·波尔和格奥尔基·穆雷桑，均为7英尺7英寸……穆格斯·博格斯是NBA史上最矮的球员，身高5英尺3英寸。”

explain.en: "Basketball remained mostly an American pastime until 1949, when the National Basketball Association (NBA) began."
explain.zh: “篮球在1949年美国职业篮球联赛（NBA）成立之前，基本只是一项美国人的消遣。”

q.en: How do the tallest and shortest NBA players compare in height?
q.zh: NBA最高和最矮的球员身高相差多少？

options.en: The tallest were 7'7" (Manute Bol and Gheorghe Muresan) and the shortest was 5'3" (Muggsy Bogues)
options.zh: 最高为7英尺7英寸（马努特·波尔和格奥尔基·穆雷桑），最矮为5英尺3英寸（穆格斯·博格斯）

options.en: The tallest was 6'10" and the shortest was 5'0", a gap the author describes as the widest ever recorded between two NBA players
options.zh: 最高6英尺10英寸，最矮5英尺，作者称这是有记录以来两名NBA球员间最大的身高差距

options.en: There is no record of player heights

explain.en: "The tallest players ever in the NBA were Manute Bol and Gheorghe Muresan, who were both 7 feet 7 inches… Muggsy Bogues was the shortest NBA player in history, at 5 feet 3 inches."
explain.zh: “NBA史上最高的球员是马努特·波尔和格奥尔基·穆雷桑，均为7英尺7英寸……穆格斯·博格斯是NBA史上最矮的球员，身高5英尺3英寸。”

q.zh: 篮板是被发明出来的原因是什么？

options.en: To help players dribble, since the early game was played against a wall without a board
options.zh: 为了帮助球员运球，因为早期比赛是靠着墙、没有篮板进行的

options.en: To stop spectators in the balcony from knocking away shots
options.zh: 为了阻止楼座上的观众把球拍掉

explain.en: A "Do You Know?" note says: "The backboard was invented to stop spectators in the balcony from knocking away shots!"
explain.zh: “你知道吗？”中写道：“篮板被发明出来，是为了阻止楼座上的观众把球拍掉！”

q.en: What does "amateur" mean in this book?
q.zh: 在本书中，“amateur”（业余的）是什么意思？

options.en: A type of basketball position, such as the one played by the team's fastest runner
options.zh: 一种篮球位置，比如由球队跑得最快的人担任的那种

options.en: Not professional; done as a hobby
options.zh: 非职业的；作为爱好来做

explain.en: The glossary defines amateur as "not professional; done as a hobby."
explain.zh: 词汇表将 amateur 定义为“非职业的；作为爱好来做”。

q.en: How many points does a team earn for a shot made from behind the three-point line?
q.zh: 球队在三分线外投中一球得几分？

options.en: Four points, given for a long shot made from behind the special three-point line
options.zh: 四分，投进特殊三分线外的远球所给的分数

explain.en: "A team earns two points for making a shot, three points for making a shot from behind the three-point line, and one point for each foul shot."
explain.zh: “投中得两分，三分线外投中得三分，每次罚球得一分。”

q.en: What is the book's focus question?
q.zh: 这本书的核心问题是什么？

options.en: "Why do people love golf?" the question printed on the book's opening title page
options.zh: “人们为什么喜欢高尔夫？”，印在书开头标题页上的问题
“篮球是如何随着时间改变的？”

explain.en: The focus question on the title page reads: "How has basketball changed over time?"
explain.zh: 标题页上的核心问题是：“篮球是如何随着时间改变的？”

q.en: Why does the book mention George Mikan?
q.zh: 书中为什么提到乔治·迈肯？

options.en: He was the first 'big man' who changed basketball into a game of giants
options.zh: 他是第一位“大个子”，把篮球变成了巨人的运动

options.en: He invented the peach basket, nailing it to the wall where players still score today
options.zh: 他发明了桃篮，把它钉在墙上，而球员至今仍在那里得分

explain.en: "He was the first of the 'big men' who changed basketball from being a sport of small and quick players into that of giants."
explain.zh: “他是‘大个子’中的第一人，把篮球从一项由矮小敏捷球员主导的运动，变成了巨人的运动。”

prompt.en: The book asks 'How has basketball changed over time?' List two changes from the book and one way the game is still the same.
prompt.zh: 书中问“篮球是如何随着时间改变的？”列出书中的两个变化，以及这项运动至今仍相同的一点。

en: Changes could include: started with a peach basket in 1891, NBA began in 1949, became global after the 1992 Dream Team.
Same: still two teams of five trying to shoot into the opponent's hoop.
zh: 变化可包括：1891年始于桃篮；1949年NBA成立；1992年“梦之队”后走向全球。
相同：仍是两队各五人，力争把球投进对方篮筐。
